title: Splunk Observability - NatWest detector firings
description: Read Splunk Observability detector firings forwarded by the alert-bridge webhook (sourcetype splunk_observability:alert) and emit one ITSI notable event per firing. Drives Episode Review for the demo's chaos scenarios.
search: index=main sourcetype="splunk_observability:alert" | spath | rename detector as o11y_detector, severity as o11y_severity, eventType as o11y_event_type, incidentId as o11y_incident_id | eval severity = case(o11y_severity="Critical","6", o11y_severity="High","5", o11y_severity="Major","5", o11y_severity="Warning","4", o11y_severity="Minor","3", o11y_severity="Info","2", true(),"3") | eval service = case(match(o11y_detector,"SWIFT"),"Payment Networks", match(o11y_detector,"payment-init"),"Payment Services", match(o11y_detector,"sanctions"),"sanctions-aml-service", match(o11y_detector,"(?i)(Bronze|Silver|Gold|tier)"),"Customer Tier Experience", match(o11y_detector,"synthetic"),"Digital Customer Experience", true(),"NatWest Card Payments") | eval title = o11y_detector, source = "Splunk Observability Cloud" | eval service_ids = case(service=="Payment Networks", "nwpay_l2_payment_networks", service=="Payment Services", "nwpay_l2_payment", service=="sanctions-aml-service", "nwpay_l3_sanctions_aml_service,nwpay_l2_business", service=="Customer Tier Experience", "nwpay_l2_customer_tier_experience,nwpay_l2_dce", service=="Digital Customer Experience", "nwpay_l2_dce", true(), "nwpay_l1") | table _time, severity, service, service_ids, title, source, o11y_detector, o11y_severity, o11y_event_type, o11y_incident_id, _raw
_comment_webhook: POSTs the JSON body of each correlation search result to the in-cluster ServiceNow simulator (helm/natwest-payments/templates/snow-simulator.yaml). The simulator records the ticket in memory and emits a sourcetype=snow:ticket log line that the glass-table 'Active incidents in ServiceNow' panel reads. If the simulator is disabled (snowSimulator.enabled=false) the webhook silently 503s and Splunk just logs a sendalert error -- the itsi_event_generator action above always runs first so Episode Review is unaffected.
action.itsi_event_generator.param.title: $result.title$
